english.note: Use this when a priest, celebrant, or other official performs the marriage ceremony for the couple.
Use 證婚 when an officiant performs or solemnizes the wedding ceremony.

examples.english: The pastor will wed the couple tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 牧師聽日會幫佢哋證婚。
examples.jyutping: muk6 si1 ting1 jat6 wui5 bong1 keoi5 dei6 zing3 fan1

examples.english: The pastor will marry us tomorrow, so don’t worry.
examples.traditional: 聽日由牧師幫我哋證婚，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping: ting1 jat6 jau4 muk6 si1 bong1 ngo5 dei6 zing3 fan1 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1
